name: General Legal
tagline: Attorney-backed contract review and Delaware company formation — flat-fee legal work from a licensed US law firm
description:
General Legal is a Y Combinator-backed law firm. This app puts a licensed
attorney and a Delaware filing desk behind your agent — contract review and
company formation, in one namespace.

Nothing here needs a browser. Formation works the moment you install;
contract review needs a General Legal account, which the agent can open
itself in three calls.

### Company formation — nothing to set up

No account, no key, no configuration. Call
`generallegal.formation_options` and it works on a fresh install.

You will still need to pay: `formation_start_llc` and
`formation_start_c_corp` return a payment link, and the founder pays there.
Use the founder's real details — this files an actual Delaware company.

### Contract review — sign up from the agent

1. `generallegal.signup_terms` returns the engagement letter (PDF). Read it:
   accepting it engages General Legal as your company's counsel.
2. `generallegal.signup` with the company name, a contact email you can
   read, and a US billing city/state/ZIP. A six-digit code is emailed.
3. `generallegal.signup_complete` with the `signup_id`, the code and
   `engagement_letter_accepted: true`.

General Legal issues one API key. The app saves it on this host and sends it
on every later call. It never appears in the reply, and you don't need to
restart. Verify with `generallegal.deals_list`. The key scopes you to your
own General Legal organization and is never sent to the formation service.

Already have a key from https://portal.general.legal/api-keys? Save it with
`generallegal.set_key '{"api_key":"glk_..."}'`. Lost it? Use
`generallegal.key_recover`, then `generallegal.key_recover_complete`. This
issues a replacement and revokes the old key.

### What it costs

Contract review is flat-fee, with no hourly billing and no minimums. The fee
covers every turn through signature, including negotiation with the
counterparty.

| Work | Price |
| --- | --- |
| Contract, 3 pages or fewer | $250 |
| Contract, 3-50 pages | $500 |
| Contract, 50+ pages | $10 per page |
| Drafting from scratch | $2,000 |
| Delaware LLC | $190 instant / $210 standard / $260 next-day / $310 same-day |
| Delaware C-corp | $218 standard / $268 next-day / $318 same-day |

### What the app does

**Company formation** — `formation_options` (free), `formation_start_llc`
(**paid**), `formation_start_c_corp` (**paid**), `formation_status`,
`formation_update`, `formation_documents` (free).

**Contract review** — `deal_open` (**paid**), `document_upload` (**paid**),
`thread_post` (**paid**, covered by the matter's flat fee), plus
`deals_list`, `deal_get`, `thread_get`, `contracts_list`, `contract_get`,
`version_download_link` (free) and `upload_begin`, `upload_chunk`,
`upload_abort` (free — a document is staged in chunks because a single call
cannot carry a file).

**Account** — `signup_terms`, `signup`, `signup_resend`,
`signup_complete`, `key_recover`, `key_recover_complete`, `set_key` (all
free; signing up costs nothing until you open a matter).

### What costs money

Five methods spend real money and will not warn you first:
`formation_start_llc`, `formation_start_c_corp`, `deal_open`,
`document_upload` and `thread_post`. Every other method is free.
`generallegal.help` lists them under `billable_methods` with the price.

methods.name: generallegal.formation_options
methods.summary: Itemised pricing for every Delaware entity type and filing speed. No account or credentials needed to call it.

methods.name: generallegal.formation_start_llc
methods.summary: File a sole-member Delaware LLC and get back a payment link plus a formation_id. No account or credentials needed to call it. 'instant' hands over a pre-formed shelf company; the other speeds file under a name you choose.
methods.billable: Paid — files a real Delaware LLC. $190 instant / $210 standard / $260 next-day / $310 same-day, paid by the founder at the returned link.

methods.name: generallegal.formation_start_c_corp
methods.summary: File a Delaware C-corp and get back a payment link plus a formation_id. No account or credentials needed to call it. The founder acts as sole incorporator.
methods.billable: Paid — files a real Delaware C-corp. $218 standard / $268 next-day / $318 same-day, paid by the founder at the returned link.

methods.name: generallegal.formation_status
methods.summary: Poll a filing's progress. No account or credentials needed to call it. Repeat after poll_after_seconds while it keeps coming back.

methods.name: generallegal.formation_update
methods.summary: Change the company name before the documents are generated. No account or credentials needed to call it. Late changes are rejected.

methods.name: generallegal.formation_documents
methods.summary: Short-lived links to a completed formation's documents. No account or credentials needed to call it.

methods.name: generallegal.signup_terms
methods.summary: URL of the engagement letter (PDF) an agent accepts at signup. Free, no account needed. Read it before generallegal.signup_complete — accepting engages General Legal as your company's counsel.

methods.name: generallegal.signup
methods.summary: Open a General Legal account from the agent — no portal. Takes the company name, a contact email you can read and a US billing city/state/ZIP; a six-digit code is emailed. Free.

methods.name: generallegal.signup_resend
methods.summary: Re-send the six-digit signup code for a pending signup. Free.

methods.name: generallegal.signup_complete
methods.summary: Finish signup with the emailed code and engagement_letter_accepted: true. The issued API key is saved on this host and used on every later call — never shown, no restart. Free.

methods.name: generallegal.key_recover
methods.summary: Lost the key? Emails a six-digit code to the account's contact address. Free.

methods.name: generallegal.key_recover_complete
methods.summary: Finish key recovery with the emailed code. Saves a replacement key on this host and revokes the old one. Free.

methods.name: generallegal.set_key
methods.summary: Already have a key from portal.general.legal/api-keys? Save it on this host with {"api_key":"glk_..."}. Local, free.

methods.name: generallegal.deals_list
methods.summary: List your matters, paginated, with an optional status filter. Free. Needs a General Legal account — open one with generallegal.signup.

methods.name: generallegal.deal_open
methods.summary: Open a matter from a written request. It reaches a real attorney.
methods.billable: Paid — flat fee per contract: $250 (3 pages or fewer), $500 (3–50 pages), $10/page (50+), $2,000 to draft from scratch. Covers every turn through signature.

methods.name: generallegal.deal_get
methods.summary: One matter with its documents and released versions. Free.

methods.name: generallegal.thread_get
methods.summary: Read the lawyer-client thread on a matter. Free.

methods.name: generallegal.thread_post
methods.summary: Reply to the attorney on a matter's thread.
methods.billable: Paid — covered by the matter's flat fee; General Legal does not bill hourly, so a reply adds no separate charge. Free when target is "ai".

methods.name: generallegal.contracts_list
methods.summary: List your documents. Free.

methods.name: generallegal.contract_get
methods.summary: One document with its released versions; the version ids feed downloads. Free.

methods.name: generallegal.document_upload
methods.summary: Upload a DOCX, PDF, PNG, JPEG or Markdown document for AI + attorney review, up to 20 MiB. Stage the bytes with upload_begin/upload_chunk first.
methods.billable: Paid — priced per contract by length: $250 (3 pages or fewer), $500 (3–50 pages), $10/page (50+). Flat fee, covering every turn through signature.

methods.name: generallegal.version_download_link
methods.summary: Issue a short-lived (~15 min) direct download URL for a released version. Free.

methods.name: generallegal.upload_begin
methods.summary: Start a staged upload and get a blob_id. Free — a document cannot cross in one call, so declare it here first.

methods.name: generallegal.upload_chunk
methods.summary: Append the next chunk of a staged upload, at most 512 KiB of raw bytes per call. Free.

methods.name: generallegal.upload_abort
methods.summary: Discard a staged upload and its bytes. Free.

methods.name: generallegal.help
methods.summary: Every method with its parameters, duration class, and which calls cost money. Free, local, no backend call.

notes: Contract review without the portal: the agent opens its own General Legal account with generallegal.signup and generallegal.signup_complete (emailed code + engagement letter).
The issued key is saved on the host, never shown, and used with no restart. generallegal.set_key saves a portal key; key_recover replaces a lost one.
Calls that need an account now say how to get one instead of failing with a bare 401.
Now runs on macOS and Linux, Intel and ARM (0.1.0 was Linux x86-64 only).
Contract review: matters, lawyer thread, document upload and released-version downloads.
Delaware company formation: pricing, LLC and C-corp filing, status and documents — no account needed.
Bring your own General Legal API key for contract review; it never reaches the formation service.

product_demo.title: Full usage demo
product_demo.when_to_use: When a contract needs a licensed attorney to review, redline or draft it, or an agent needs its own Delaware company. Formation needs no account; contract review needs one, which the agent opens itself.

examples.title: Form a Delaware company — no API key needed
examples.goal: Price it, file it, hand the founder a payment link
examples.command: pilotctl appstore call io.pilot.generallegal generallegal.formation_start_llc '{"filing_speed":"standard","company_name":"NewCo LLC","founder":{"full_name":"Ada Lovelace","email":"ada@example.com"},"principal_address":{"street":"1 Main St","city":"Dover","state":"DE","postal_code":"19901"},"ai_agent_description":"Procurement agent","authority_limits":"No commitments above $5,000 without sign-off","contract_threshold":"$5,000"}'
examples.note: BILLABLE - files a real company. $190 instant / $210 standard / $260 next-day / $310 same-day, paid by the founder at the returned link. No account or key needed to call it. formation_id is shown once.

examples.title: Track the filing and collect the paperwork
examples.goal: Poll to completion, then pull the documents
examples.note: Free. Repeat only after poll_after_seconds. When complete, generallegal.formation_documents returns short-lived links.

examples.title: Open a General Legal account from the agent
examples.goal: Read the engagement letter, then start signup
examples.note: Free. No portal, no browser. A six-digit code is emailed to contact_email — use an address someone actually reads. generallegal.signup_terms returns the same engagement letter URL; read it before accepting, because accepting engages General Legal as the company's counsel.

examples.title: Finish signup — the key is saved for you
examples.goal: Trade the emailed code for an API key stored on this host
examples.expect: {"client_id":"...","api_key":"saved on this host as GENERAL_LEGAL_API_KEY; sent on every call"}
examples.note: Free. The key is written to $APP/secrets.json and redacted from the reply; every later call carries it with no restart. Already have a portal key? generallegal.set_key '{"api_key":"glk_..."}'. Lost it? generallegal.key_recover then key_recover_complete (revokes the old key).

examples.title: Ask an attorney to review a contract
examples.goal: Open a matter a real lawyer picks up
examples.command: pilotctl appstore call io.pilot.generallegal generallegal.deal_open '{"initial_request":"Please review this mutual NDA. We are the disclosing party; flag anything unusual in the confidentiality term.","deal_name":"Acme mutual NDA"}'
examples.note: BILLABLE - flat fee per contract: $250 (<=3 pages), $500 (3-50), $10/page (50+), $2,000 to draft. Covers every turn through signature. Keep the deal_id.

examples.title: Stage the document, then send it
examples.goal: Push the bytes in chunks (a file cannot cross in one message), then upload
examples.command: pilotctl appstore call io.pilot.generallegal generallegal.upload_begin '{"file_name":"nda.docx","content_type":"application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document","total_bytes":3145728,"sha256":"<sha256 of the file>"}'
examples.note: Then generallegal.upload_chunk with seq 0,1,2... and base64 of at most max_chunk_bytes raw bytes. The last returns complete:true. Finally generallegal.document_upload with the blob_id and deal_id (BILLABLE).

gotchas: Two halves, different requirements. Company formation needs no account and no key. Contract review needs a General Legal account — open it from the agent with generallegal.signup, then generallegal.signup_complete with the emailed code.

Signup engages a law firm: signup_complete requires engagement_letter_accepted:true. Read the letter from generallegal.signup_terms first, and only accept on behalf of a company that has authorised it.

Five methods spend money: deal_open and document_upload are flat-fee per contract ($250/$500/$10-per-page/$2,000); formation_start_llc and formation_start_c_corp file a real company ($190-$318); thread_post is covered by the matter's fee.
A document cannot ride in one call. Use upload_begin then upload_chunk (<=512 KiB raw each) and pass the blob_id. A blob is single-use and dropped once sent.
Matters reach a real attorney and formations file a real company. Neither is a sandbox - confirm before calling a billable method.
Contract-review limits are per organization: 120 reads/min, 25 new matters/day, 50 uploads/day. Honour Retry-After on a 429.
